headline: The Heartspring deposit is the one thing that can't wait — and Leila's grant door is still open.
story:
Money is moving at Heartspring: Maya needs the deposit confirmed by end of day or the spring order slips a week. That's the day's one hard deadline.

On the BDA side it's quiet — but usefully quiet: Zachary's report landed and the ABO fund math is settled, so you can close that loop with the board whenever you're ready.

Personally, Ari is still waiting on a dinner answer (day 2), and tomorrow morning is fuller than it looks — the greenhouse call at 9 needs the supplier numbers you haven't received yet.

arcs.title: The spring order deposit
arcs.stakes: The whole spring planting order hangs on this confirmation.
arcs.soFar: Maya flagged the deposit Monday; you asked for the revised quote Tuesday and it hasn't come back.
arcs.today: Maya escalated: she needs confirmation before end of day for the order to proceed.
arcs.heading: Confirm today and the order ships on schedule; miss it and planting slips a week.
arcs.needs: A two-line confirmation reply — draft is ready.

actions.label: Send the confirmation
actions.subject: Re: Deposit confirmation needed today
actions.body:
Hi Maya,

Confirmed — go ahead with the deposit as quoted. I'll have the remaining details to you by tomorrow morning.

Thanks for keeping this on track,
Ben

arcs.memory: Confirmed deposit 7/25 (pending Ben's send). Watch for Maya's shipping confirmation; revised supplier quote still outstanding.

arcs.title: ABO funds: the math is settled
arcs.stakes: Board needs a clean number before directing this year's ABO allocation.
arcs.soFar: You asked Zachary for last FY's ABO figures two weeks ago; he sent the report: $16,670 carried over.
arcs.today: Quiet. Nothing new — the loop is yours to close.
arcs.heading: One summary note to the board and this arc is done.
arcs.memory: ABO carryover confirmed at $16,670. Waiting on Ben to summarize to board; then close.

arcs.title: Dinner with Ari
arcs.stakes: Small, but it's day 2 — friends notice.
arcs.today: Ari asked again: Wednesday or Thursday?
arcs.heading: Thursday looks clearer on your calendar.

actions.label: Say Thursday
actions.subject: Re: Dinner this week?
actions.body:
Thursday works great — 7ish? Looking forward to it.

Ben

arcs.memory: Proposed Thursday dinner to Ari on 7/25; awaiting confirmation.

decisions.question: Confirm Maya's deposit today?
decisions.context: Order proceeds only with today's confirmation; the revised quote you wanted hasn't arrived, but the base quote stands.
decisions.leaning: Yes — the quote delta is small and a week's slip costs more.

action.label: Yes — send the confirmation
action.subject: Re: Deposit confirmation needed today
action.body:
Hi Maya,

Confirmed — go ahead.

Ben

quickHits.text: Supplier Desk still owes you the revised quote — day 2 of waiting.

noise.note: one newsletter, one promo — the Local Food Digest had the market schedule if you want it later.
